name: Synthesys
summary: Synthesys generates AI voiceovers and avatar videos for marketing, e-learning, and presentations. It offers realistic voices, facial animation, and multi-language support.
description:
Synthesys generates AI voiceovers and avatar videos for marketing, e-learning, and presentations. It offers realistic voices, facial animation, and multi-language support.

Create AI video ads, UGC & commercials in minutes. Trusted by Coca-Cola & Yahoo. 10X faster, 90%+ cheaper than traditional production.

Wide variety of synthetic voices. Text-to-video with talking avatars. Supports 50+ languages for global reach. Branded video templates and customization.

pricing.label: Premium
pricing.note: Price label carried over from the previous catalog and not rechecked.

howToUse.title: Sign Up and Access Dashboard
howToUse.description: Create a Synthesys account and log in to the platform to access voiceover and avatar video tools.

howToUse.title: Input or Paste Script
howToUse.description: Enter your script for voiceover or avatar video generation. Select the language and style you prefer.

howToUse.title: Choose Voice and Avatar
howToUse.description: Pick from a library of AI voices and talking avatars. Adjust parameters for tone, speed, and accent as needed.

howToUse.title: Generate and Preview Media
howToUse.description: Click to generate your audio or video. Preview the result and make further edits if required.

howToUse.title: Download or Integrate
howToUse.description: Download your voiceover/video file or use integrations to publish directly to your marketing platforms.
